plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: Spec-driven Claude Code plugin. Split into two stages joined by a task queue: a planning session audits the repo for the work worth doing, grills business + technical goals as distinct passes, and plans a dependency-ordered task graph; build sessions take ready tasks hands-off, ship one stacked PR per layer, and one read-only master QA reviews the whole stack at the end. Product memory is five prose Markdown docs read whole in .claude/ (product.md for North Star + Language, plus roadmap.md, architecture.md, lessons.md, examples.md); the task graph lives in the @outputty/tasks-mcp MCP server, synced two-way to GitHub Issues. Every decision lives in those docs and nowhere else; the laziest-working-diff build discipline is owned in-plugin.
